editorial:
Ever feel like you just want to get paid for doing absolutely nothing? That is exactly where Carlos finds himself in this quirky story. After spending years failing to find a real job, he stumbles upon a company that actually pays people to sit around and do zero work. It sounds like a dream come true, right? The movie starts off with a light, funny feel as you watch Carlos try to navigate the weird rules of this strange workplace. You will quickly realize that while the job seems easy, the mental toll of doing nothing is actually way harder than it looks. 

What really makes this work is the acting and the slow build of tension as Carlos starts to lose his mind from the boredom. The pacing is steady, though it might feel a bit slow for some, but that is kind of the point. It is a great pick for anyone who has ever felt stuck in a dead-end job or a boring routine. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp look, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a big twist when you realize the company is not actually a business, but a social experiment. Carlos finds out that the goal was to see how long a human could survive without any purpose or activity. After pushing him to his limit, the company lets him go. He eventually learns that true happiness comes from working toward a goal and feeling useful, rather than just collecting a paycheck for nothing.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird workplace comedies and stories about the meaning of life.
